    What we fix

    Shop work, without the shop

    No tow, no waiting room, no rental car. The work happens where the car already is — and if you already bought the parts, we'll install them.

    01

    Brakes

    Pads and rotors in your driveway — the squeal, grind or soft pedal gone the same visit.

    02

    Starters, alternators & batteries

    The no-start trio. We diagnose which one it actually is before you pay for the wrong part.

    03

    Engine & hybrid diagnostics

    Check-engine lights, drivability problems and hybrid battery diagnostics — including the codes shops charge just to read.

    04

    Pre-purchase inspections

    Buying a used car? We inspect it where it sits, before your money moves — brakes, leaks, codes, the works.

    05

    Keys & fobs programmed

    Lost the fob or need a spare? Key and remote programming without dealership prices or dealership waits.

    06

    Oil, tune-ups & suspension

    Oil changes, tune-ups, radiators, motor mounts and suspension work — maintenance that comes to your house.

    07

    Your parts, installed

    Already bought the parts? Smart. We install them — plus dash-cams, underglow, rock lights and basic performance installs.

    Fair prices — way cheaper than shops.
